freePlan.limits: Fully free and open source under Apache 2.0; costs come from the infrastructure or managed service running it

cautions.en: Kubernetes itself has no license fee; the real cost is the compute, storage and managed control-plane fees charged by the cloud provider or self-hosted infrastructure running it.

capabilities.en: Container orchestration: automated deployment, scaling and management of containerized applications.
Self-healing (automatic restarts, rescheduling and replacement of failed containers) and rolling updates/rollbacks.
Service discovery, load balancing and declarative configuration via YAML manifests.

limitations.en: Steep learning curve and significant operational complexity compared to simpler deployment platforms (e.g. Heroku, Netlify).
Requires ongoing cluster operations (upgrades, security patching, networking) unless using a fully managed offering.

reason.en: Simpler managed container deployment platform for teams that don't need full Kubernetes.
Offers a managed Kubernetes service as a simpler entry point to container orchestration.
Provides managed Kubernetes (EKS) alongside its own container orchestration options.

missingAlternatives.name: Docker Swarm
missingAlternatives.reason: Simpler built-in container orchestration alternative to Kubernetes, not in the catalogue

missingAlternatives.name: Nomad
missingAlternatives.reason: HashiCorp's lighter-weight workload orchestrator, an alternative to Kubernetes, not in the catalogue
